subject: Paediatric dosing calculating wrong again
body:
Hi Priya,

Wanted to flag - dosing calculations have been off for a couple weeks now for our paediatric patients above 40kg. Support said this was a known issue.

Chris

subject: Re: Paediatric dosing calculating wrong again
body:
Hi Chris,

Thanks for flagging, sorry for the trouble. Our eng team is aware and actively working a fix for the above-40kg band specifically. I'll loop in Jordan on timing.

Priya

subject: Dosing fix timeline
body:
Hi Chris,

Following up from Priya's note - I checked with engineering and we're targeting September 5th to have the paediatric dosing calculation issue for patients above 40kg fully resolved. I'll personally confirm once it's out.

Appreciate your patience, especially given how much your paediatric ward relies on this.

Jordan

subject: Dosing engine v2 GA this week
body:
Team,

Planning to announce dosing engine v2 as GA this week (async pipeline, EHR write-back, paediatric + adult dosing tables). Clinical safety has signed off on adult and paediatric bands up to 40kg. Sarah flagged the above-40kg edge case as a follow-up item, tracking separately so it doesn't hold up the announcement. Will post in #eng once it's live.

Emily

subject: Dosing still wrong - you said this shipped
body:
Hi team,

Following up again. Jordan told us on August 25th that the paediatric dosing issue would be fixed by September 5th. Then last week (September 3rd) we saw the announcement that dosing engine v2 had shipped, so we tried again for our paediatric ward - doses above 40kg are still calculating wrong, exact same behavior as before.

You told us this shipped last week. At this point we need a real answer, not another announcement, and our clinical team needs to know whether they can trust the system for these patients.

Dr. Chris Whitfield
St. Anne's Children's Hospital

subject: Re: Dosing still wrong - you said this shipped
body:
Hi Chris,

I'm very sorry - you're right, and I want to be straight with you this time instead of giving another premature timeline. The specific paediatric dosing issue above 40kg you're describing is still open on our end (tracked internally as MED-412), there's a fix in code review right now. I won't call this resolved again until it's verified for a paediatric weight range like yours. Setting up a call for tomorrow to talk through interim options, including manual double-checks for affected patients.

Jordan

subject: St. Anne's situation
body: Marcus - saw the thread with st. anne's. Can we get a real fix + verification plan by EOW, not just another 'shipped' announcement? This is a patient-safety issue and a renewal risk. Let's sync tomorrow.\n\nTom

subject: Re: St. Anne's situation
body: Yep - sarah's PR (#288) adds the paediatric rounding fix, that's the real fix. Holding the merge until clinical safety verifies it end to end for the full paediatric weight range, don't want to repeat the same mistake. Should have a real answer by wednesday.\n\nMarcus

subject: Following up on dosing engine v2 demo
body:
Hi there,

Great chatting earlier this week! As promised, here's a recap of the dosing engine v2 features we covered - the async calculation pipeline, EHR write-back, and paediatric + adult dosing tables. Happy to set up a sandbox environment whenever you're ready.

Best,
Amir

subject: Re: HL7 export delimiter question
body:
Hi there,

Yes, custom delimiters (pipe/caret) have been supported since v1.4 - you can set this under Export Settings > HL7 Format. Let me know if you run into any issues.

Priya

subject: Welcome Lena to the team!
body:
Hi all,

Please join us in welcoming Lena Fischer, joining the frontend team this week. Lena previously worked at a health-tech startup and is excited to dig into the scheduling UI work.

HR

subject: Re: Dosing fix timeline
body: Thanks Jordan, appreciate the specific date. We'll plan to re-test on our end for the paediatric ward once you confirm it's live.\n\nChris

subject: PR 288 review notes
body: Hey - reviewing #288 now. Rounding table lookup looks right, left a couple small comments. Did you get a chance to test against paediatric weight profiles closer to st. anne's actual patient mix? Want to make sure we're not re-announcing this before it's really solid.\n\nDavid

subject: Re: PR 288 review notes
body: Good call - only tested synthetic profiles up to 60kg so far, st. anne's paediatric ward sees patients up to around 90kg. Spinning up a bigger synthetic test set today before we merge, want this actually verified this time.\n\nSarah

subject: St. Anne's renewal risk
body: Flagging st. anne's renewal (in ~6 weeks) is now at risk given the repeated paediatric dosing issues and the 'shipped' miscommunication. Want to make sure we don't over-promise again before #288 is actually verified.\n\nJordan
